_about: Reader-language copy for the public changelog at /changelog/. Keyed by pull request number. scripts/build-changelog.mjs joins this to the merged pull requests on main and writes changelog.json. Categories: data, results, model, pages, corrections. An entry with omit: true is left out of the public list (dependency bumps, CI and internal tooling) and must say why. A merged pull request with no entry here makes the script fail, so nothing reaches the page in developer language.
